_comment: S5's input: which functions WRITE each state region, projected out of the state
matrix so that `--check` needs no Ghidra and no 7 MB artefact.
WHY IT IS COMMITTED. Until 2026-09-01 gen_seam_surface read the matrix directly, which
made it the one lint_repo gate that hard-failed on a fresh clone -- green for whoever
had run the Ghidra script, red for everyone else. gen_region_accessors.fingerprints()
states the contract: fingerprinting the matrix 'would make --check unrunnable on a
fresh clone, which is the opposite of the offline contract every other generator here
keeps'. Same fix gen_dll_shadow.py already uses for its region sets.
STORES ONLY -- an `imm`/`addr_of` cell is an address TAKE, not a write, and counting
one inflates every closure (the rule derive_write_closure applies).
CURRENCY IS A GATE, NOT A HABIT: `_provenance` stamps the matrix totals this was built
from, and --check compares them against the committed docs/state-matrix.md summary row.
